items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: I stayed with Duke ... Duke got a call from overseas ... His real name was Edward

ctx.x: And how long were you with Duke?

Well, I stayed with Duke -- I'm coming to that. I stayed with Duke and we made records and records and records. And finally, Duke got a call from overseas to play at the Royal Palladium in London. And Duke told me -- and I'll tell you, Duke was a guy -- he had such a nice disposition, he was a swell fellow. And he carried himself so nicely. That's why that nickname, Duke. He got that name. His real name was Edward, but he got that nickname in Washington, D.C. That was his home. And the way he carried himself was…
